Tender zucchini, shiitake mushrooms, and sliced rice cakes are tucked throughout to create a satisfying texturally diverse meal. The inclusion of perilla leaves and sesame oil adds an authentic fragrant finish right before serving. This hearty preparation delivers substantial amounts of plant-based protein, dietary fiber, and essential minerals like iron and potassium.
